scripts.build: tsc -b packages/schema packages/core packages/node packages/next packages/store apps/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/schema packages/core packages/node packages/next packages/store apps/server && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.app:create: npm run build --silent && node apps/server/dist/cli.js create
scripts.app:disable: npm run build --silent && node apps/server/dist/cli.js disable
scripts.app:list: npm run build --silent && node apps/server/dist/cli.js list
scripts.events:tail: npm run build --silent && node apps/server/dist/cli.js events
scripts.findings: npm run build --silent && node apps/server/dist/cli.js findings
scripts.agents:once: npm run build --silent && node apps/server/dist/cli.js agents-once
scripts.demo:next: npm run build --silent && npm run build -w @abigaail/demo-next && npm run start -w @abigaail/demo-next
